description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for parsing and monitoring OVSDB update events, including update types, callbacks, and parsing utilities.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_start
methods.description: Initializes the parsing of an OVSDB update from a JSON object.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_next
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next update.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_get_table
methods.description: Returns the table name associated with the current parsed update.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_get_uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the current parsed update.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_get_new
methods.description: Returns the new row data in JSON format.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_parse_get_old
methods.description: Returns the old row data in JSON format.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor_ex
methods.description: Starts monitoring a specific table for updates with specific columns.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_monitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring a table for updates on all columns.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_changed
methods.description: Checks if a specific field has changed in the update.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_update_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts an update type enum to its string representation.
